text: prerna dhi, i have a suggestion which my mom always does. i'm an hourglass, always kurtis end up getting tight towards hip. what my mother does is, she will remove the stitches near the hip and keep it open for few inches above and to balance that proportions i pair it with a loose plazo or skirt. in your case i can suggest you the same. remove stitches for 2 inches and close the hem on the sides and pair it with the same yellow ghagra you bought from fabindia which you wore in the beginning of youtube journey. also you made a video on how to style lehngas in many ways, you experimented with that lehnga only. i hope it gives a monochrome look because i feel the shade match will be 98 close. if the shade doesn't match, you bought a red skirt for a 90s inspired look video from fabindia. red yellow are classics, so you can pair with that too. although i personally feel this trick saves a lot of kurtis in my closet, give it a shot and see the flow of magic happen please ek reply kardo prerna ji. waiting for your reply for my tip. whoever like the tip - give a like to this comment and also please please please follow prerna dhi. she does magic with outfits
author: @beemanpallyaishwarya3507
original_text:
Prerna dhi, I have a suggestion which my mom always does. I'm an hourglass, always Kurtis end up getting tight towards hip. What my mother does is, she will remove the stitches near the hip and keep it open for few inches above and to balance that proportions I pair it with a loose plazo or skirt. In your case I can suggest you the same. Remove stitches for 2 inches and close the hem on the sides and pair it with the same yellow ghagra you bought from fabindia which you wore in the beginning of YouTube journey. Also you made a video on how to style lehngas in many ways, you experimented with that lehnga only. I hope it gives a monochrome look because I feel the shade match will be 98% close. If the shade doesn't match, you bought a red skirt for a 90s inspired look video from fabindia. Red yellow are classics, so you can pair with that too. Although I personally feel this trick saves a lot of Kurtis in my closet, give it a shot and see the flow of magic happen 
Please ek reply kardo prerna ji. Waiting for your reply for my tip. 
Whoever like the tip - give a like to this comment and also please please please follow prerna dhi. She does magic with outfits❤
